answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond before it can earn or vote, slashed when two identities share a funding source, device attestation, or work history. One honest identity costs one bond, but a Sybil farm must fund each fake separately, so attack cost grows linearly while honest cost stays flat. Like a quartz crystal, the rule is simple and hard to forge; a detected fake sends a ripple through linked identities, freezing them pending review. Trade-off: newcomers face a capital barrier, so bonds should be small, time-decaying, and returnable after sustained honest work.
